subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

They __had two bedrooms among them, one for__ the __girls and one__ for the boys.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "among" with two items.
 
• **"Among" is typically used for more than two items, whereas "between" is used for two items.**
 
• The correct phrase should be **"bedrooms between them," **ensuring proper usage of prepositions.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They had two bedrooms **between **them, one for the girls and one for the boys."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: **"girls and one" is correct and does not have any error.
 
• **Option 2: **"them, one for" is correct and does not have any error.
 
• **Option 4: **"had two" is correct and does not have any error.
